Name: Forest Spring Replaces Spouse Room
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Changes your spouse's room to look like a forest bathroom
Description:
Changes your spouse's room to look like a forest spring!

_Details_

*   Replaces spouseroom with a forest themed bathroom
_Quick start_

*   Install [smapi ](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400)﻿and unzip this mod into your mods folder

*   You're ready to go
_Compatibility and installation_

*   Pretty simple you can add/remove it mid save

*   Compatible with multiple spouse / custom spouse rooms but you might become a land shark if you don't leave the bath the way you went in. Also you should use the manual spouse selection config

*   Will not change custom NPC rooms, can be edited to do so but I won't do that unless the NPC mod author ask

*   Can be used in multiplayer, but you need to use the manual spouse selection config

*   Mobile compatible
_Mods that work well with this one_

*   [True Natural Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10732)﻿
If you like this I have a [ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart) you can donate to, where you can commission some art﻿﻿. You can also show your support by commenting on this mod and telling me what you liked.
Thanks to Nuztalgia for helping me figure out keeping the tilesheet animations
